messages:
mira: I pushed a stricter package.json exports map for @redwood-inference/sdk to enforce ESM. Several internal Next/Vercel sample apps started 500ing on edge builds.

sam: stack trace?

mira: vercel build error: Error: Cannot find module '/node_modules/@redwood-inference/sdk' when edge lambda imports it. Node server containers are fine.

lee: what's the exports map now?

mira: "exports": { ".": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs" }, "./types": "./dist/index.d.ts" }

sam: problems: (1) many edge resolvers expect file fallbacks or main/module; (2) ./types subpath doesn't satisfy older TS. Bundlers sometimes only check package root.

lee: fix: add top-level main/module/types, expand exports with browser/default and a ./* wildcard, and ship edge.mjs at package root that re-exports the ESM build.

mira: also found a dynamic require in a test helper that breaks ESM-only bundles. We'll convert to named ESM exports and add a tiny CJS shim if needed.

sam: add an edge-like CI smoke test (vercel dev or bun) for sample-apps and a changelog blurb with pin guidance.

mira: plan: restore main/module/types, add edge.mjs, expand exports, remove dynamic require, add smoke CI, update changelog. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/452

deploy-bot: queued patch branch mira/sdk-exports-compat -> staging

lee: prefer patch release with compatibility shims; avoid semver-major unless intentional.
